'''Broken Wing''' was a [[Mutated Geonosian]] warrior brought to [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] by [[Darth Malora]] to be used against the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] during the [[Invasion of Ossus]]. He participated in an attack on [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] farms, but was killed.<ref>{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=heroic|Hold the Line|Ossus}}</ref>
